Regular Hours

Fall 2026 – Winter 2027

Fall hours of operation will begin on Wednesday, August 26, 2026. All locations have limited hours during and just before or after holidays and breaks. If you are planning to visit us during a holiday or break period, please check the individual dining hall, café, market, or grill for today’s hours of service.
